run_vis_est_poses: run the vis_est_poses script to visualize 3D object pose estimates from BOP result CSV files
run_renderer_create: run renderer.create_renderer to create a vispy cpp or python 3D mesh renderer for BOP datasets
run_vis_object_poses: run visualization.vis_object_poses to render 3D object models overlaid on RGB or depth images
run_load_bop_results: run inout.load_bop_results to load pose estimates from a BOP format CSV file into a list of dicts
run_get_split_params: run dataset_params.get_split_params to load BOP dataset split parameters including image paths and camera info
